module.label: E-Signature
module.description: Prepare, send and track document signing through an approved provider, with the full audit trail kept in the CRM.

page.title: E-Signature
page.subtitle: Provider connections are administered here; the signature request workspace arrives in phase 19-ES.6.
page.loadFailed: The module could not be loaded.
page.loadFailedHint: Check that you hold the module read right and that an administrator has switched the module on.
page.notEnabled: E-Signature is switched off on this instance, so no signature request can be prepared or sent.
page.gateClosed: No signature request can be sent yet.

gateReasons.ready: An enabled provider connection exists, so an authorized operation will be carried out.
gateReasons.module_disabled: The module is switched off in the settings.
gateReasons.connections_disabled: Provider connection administration is switched off in the settings.
gateReasons.encryption_key_missing: ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured, so a stored credential cannot be read and no connection can be used.
gateReasons.no_enabled_connection: No DocuSign connection is authorized and active. An administrator has to authorize one first.

page.adminNote: An administrator can switch the module and its features on under Settings, Integrations, E-Signature.

features.title: Features
features.hint: A switch does something only once the module is on and the phase that implements the feature has shipped.
features.enabledHint: Switches the whole module on: the menu entry, the settings and every command.

settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
settings.secretRefused: This field cannot hold a secret; provider credentials are stored only in the encrypted vault.
settings.integrationKeysHint: These are OAuth client ids, which are public by nature. The matching client secret is never a settings field.
settings.embeddedReturnHosts: Hosts an embedded signing view may return to
settings.embeddedReturnHostsHint: An embedded signing link may only return to one of these hosts. No host means no embedded signing can be started.
settings.endpointUrl: Webhook endpoint to register with the provider
settings.requireHmac: Require a verified signature for every event
settings.requireHmacHint: Leave this on. Turning it off lets any caller change a contract state.
settings.webhookPayloadDays: Days the minimized event payload is kept
settings.completedArtifactDays: Days signed documents and completion evidence are kept
settings.completedArtifactDaysHint: A value of 0 means nothing is deleted automatically. Dropping the evidence of a signed contract needs a reviewed policy.
settings.requiredForSourceEntities: Source record types that always need approval

connections.title: Provider connections
connections.loadFailed: The provider connections could not be loaded.
connections.emptyHint: Create one with its OAuth client secret, then authorize it. Nothing can be sent until a connection is authorized and active.
connections.environmentHint: Demo and production are separate integrations, secrets and accounts. An existing connection is never switched between them.
connections.clientIdHint: Public by nature. Leave it empty to use the key configured in the module settings.
connections.redirectUriHint: Exactly the URI registered with this DocuSign integration, and it has to point at this platform callback path.
connections.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Nothing in this screen can read a secret back.
connections.secretWriteOnly: This writes to the encrypted vault. A stored credential is never returned by any read.
connections.disconnectConfirmHint: Its credentials are destroyed and provider calls stop. Requests, events, signed documents and audit rows are kept.
connections.disconnectedWithHistory: Disconnected; {credentials} credential(s) destroyed. Existing signature requests were kept.
connections.fakeAdapterNote: A {mode} adapter answered, so nothing reached DocuSign.
